test_cases.name: Verbose Quote Request for Multiple Toys and Apparel
test_cases.description: A detailed, context-rich initial email from WonderToys Co. requesting a quote for several items, with explanations and extra context, in a neutral tone. Sets up for a follow-up approval after the quote is provided.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote: Toys and Apparel for Upcoming Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out on behalf of WonderToys Co. as we are preparing for our upcoming spring promotional campaign and would like to request a formal sales quote for several items from your catalog. We are particularly interested in products that have performed well in the educational and play categories, as well as some apparel options for our staff and event giveaways. Please see the list below:

1. SmartyToys Educational Puzzle – We would like pricing for 25 units. This item has been popular in our previous campaigns, and we are considering it again for our educational outreach kits.
2. T-Shirt – We noticed there are several T-Shirt listings in your catalog. Could you please provide a quote for 40 T-Shirts? We are looking for a mix of sizes suitable for adults, but we are not sure which of the T-Shirt options (AITEM-0022, AITEM-0023, AITEM-0024, or AITEM-0025) would be most appropriate for event staff. Please advise or include details for each if possible.
3. JoySprout Toy Car Set – 15 units. This is intended for our interactive play stations at the event.

If you require any additional information to prepare the quote, please let us know. We would appreciate receiving the quote at your earliest convenience so we can finalize our event planning and move forward with the order process as soon as possible.

Best regards,
WonderToys Co.

test_cases.name: Verbose Quote Request for Multiple Items
test_cases.description: A detailed and polite initial quote request from Fresh HelloFoods, listing several catalog items with context and rationale for each selection.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – Multiple Items for Upcoming Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. We are preparing for an upcoming promotional event at Fresh HelloFoods and would like to request a formal sales quote for a selection of items from your catalog. To ensure we have the necessary products in stock and can plan our marketing accordingly, could you please provide pricing and availability for the following:

1. T-Shirt – We noticed you have several T-Shirt options listed (e.g., AITEM-0022, AITEM-0023, AITEM-0024, AITEM-0025). We are interested in stocking a variety, but could you please quote us for "T-Shirt" in general? We are open to your recommendations on which model(s) would be most suitable for a family-friendly grocery store setting.

2. Pizza (Item No: AITEM-0050) – Please include pricing for 20 units. This is for our prepared foods section, and we are particularly interested in any details regarding shelf life or storage requirements.

3. Green Pepper (Item No: AITEM-1006) – We would like a quote for 50 units, as this is a staple in our produce section.

If you need any additional information to prepare the quote, please let us know. We appreciate your assistance and look forward to your detailed response so we can move forward with our planning.

Best regards,
Fresh HelloFoods

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for multiple items with context
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing extra context and explanations, in an informal tone. The email sets up the business context for a later quote approval, as required by the scenario.

initial_turn.subject: Looking for a quote on a few items for our upcoming event
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

Hope you're doing well! I'm reaching out because we're organizing a small community event next month and need to get a quote for a few things. I want to make sure we have everything lined up in advance, so I figured I'd start with a quote to get an idea of the costs and availability.

Here's what we're looking for:
- 2 JoySprout Toy Bicycles (these will be used as prizes for the kids' games)
- 3 T-Shirts (we'll use these for volunteers, but I'm not sure which of the T-Shirt options would be best for this purpose, so please let me know what you recommend or if you need more info)
- 1 WonderWash Washing Machine (for our event clean-up crew)
- 5 Mango (for the snack table)

If you need any more details, just let me know! Looking forward to your quote so we can get things moving.

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson

test_cases.name: Verbose, Impatient Quote Request for Multiple Items
test_cases.description: A verbose and impatient customer from French Cafe requests a quote for several items, providing excessive context and expressing frustration with previous delays. The email includes detailed explanations and a list of requested products, reflecting the verbose persona and rude/impatient tone.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request – Please Respond Quickly This Time
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out yet again because your team has been incredibly slow in responding to our previous quote requests, which is frankly unacceptable given our tight schedule. We need to finalize our order for the upcoming event at French Cafe, and I really hope you can actually get this right without wasting more of our time.

Here’s what we need quoted:
- 10 units of the SmartToys Jigsaw Puzzle Set. This is for our kids’ corner, and we need them ASAP.
- 15 T-Shirts. I don’t care which model you quote, but make sure they’re suitable for staff uniforms. You have several T-Shirts listed, so just pick the ones that fit a standard cafe staff look (and don’t ask me for more details, you should know what works).
- 2 Rasta Drip Coffee Makers for our barista station.

If you need more info, don’t bother calling—just email back. I expect a quote by end of day, and I don’t want any more delays.

French Cafe

Best regards,
French Cafe
